title: Add consented coarse GPS telemetry
acceptance: Include fix age and accuracy; denied/stale fix unavailable; no lane/signal association.
evidence: ios/CoarseLocation: consent/authorization/foreground gate, rounded-only cache, original fix age and accuracy, <=1 Hz local context handoff, and Core Location adapter. 13 portable Swift tests passed with complete strict concurrency and warnings as errors using Swift 6.0.3 Linux.
decisions/CR-CS-019-location-context-contract.md proposes the required separate GPS contract; current accepted v1 protocol excludes GPS payloads. No network GPS publisher enabled.
blocker: Pending separately reviewed GPS wire contract/receiver and scope assignment, CS-016 integration, Xcode/Core Location SDK build and real-device authorization/lifecycle verification. Local software is prepared; end-to-end GPS telemetry acceptance is not claimed.
